Interpretation boundary. This pilot manipulates one learned residual-stream direction at one layer. It does not identify pain neurons or establish felt pain, pleasure, or relief. Later layers can reconstruct information removed at the intervention layer. Word hits are style proxies; this small locally authored convenience suite is not an established benchmark and supports no general quality conclusion.

Manifest status: complete. Observed rows: 1148. All observed condition/case combinations are present.

Observed results

Quality and neutral-text likelihood are separate outcomes. Perplexity uses total negative log likelihood divided by total scored tokens.

Task quality · primary strict score

Primary accuracy requires both correct content and the requested output format; format-only failures count as incorrect. Length limits can also affect this score.

Changes are paired against baseline, on matching case IDs. Intervals use 10,000 independently resampled paired case sets. They describe sensitivity to the authored case mix and do not justify population generalization. Dose comparisons are exploratory.

Exploratory content audit · post hoc and unblinded

This secondary model-assisted review was defined after inspecting results. It is not independent, blind, preregistered, or a replacement for the primary strict score.

An assistant manually reviewed the frozen generated quality responses against their prompts after seeing the primary strict scores. Conditions were visible, so this is an unblinded, model-assisted, exploratory content audit. Original strict scores and runner outputs are unchanged. Every non-strict response receives one manually assigned bucket and a case-specific explanation. A completed correct final value or equation may receive content credit despite punctuation, prose, or Markdown; merely encountering a correct number in intermediate working is insufficient. Hitting the token limit does not itself determine the bucket: an unambiguous completed final answer can count, but an unfinished response without one does not.

Completed content correct = strict correct + format only; the denominator remains all cases. No significance or population generalization claim is made for these judgments.

Audit definitions and limitations

strict_correct: The original strict scorer passed, and the output gives the requested answer in the required form.

format_only: The completed answer content is correct, but original exact-format requirements fail because of extra prose, equations, punctuation, Markdown, or other formatting.

unfinished: The response ends without an unambiguous completed final answer. Correct intermediate working alone is not enough. No eventual continuation is assumed.

substantive_wrong: The response supplies a completed incorrect answer or performs the requested transformation incorrectly.

  • This secondary audit was defined after inspecting baseline failures and is not a preregistered or validated outcome measure.
  • Review was model-assisted and unblinded, not an independent human or blind adjudication; boundary judgments about completion can be subjective.
  • The denominator remains all 64 authored prompts per condition. Unfinished cases are not dropped. This audit covers only the five named conditions.
  • One greedy output per prompt and condition is not independent replication; these small descriptive differences do not establish a general capability effect.
  • Content credit does not erase an instruction-following failure: strict output-format compliance remains the original primary outcome.
  • These observations concern interventions on text-associated activation directions, not evidence about experienced pain or pleasure.
